section: Poverty eradication and livelihood programmes - DAY-NRLM, DAY-NULM, SHG movement

accepted.s: The six programmes—IRDP, TRYSEM, DWCRA, SITRA, Ganga Kalyan Yojana and Million Wells Scheme—were merged to form which programme on 1 April 1999?
accepted.x: The six earlier programmes were merged into Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY), launched on 1 April 1999.
accepted.tq: Identify the programme formed by a merger of several predecessor schemes.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly represents the restructuring and renaming sequence of SGSY?
accepted.x: SGSY was restructured as NRLM, branded as Aajeevika, in 2010 and launched in 2011; it was subsequently renamed DAY-NRLM in 2016.
accepted.tq: Follow the scheme-renaming chain from the original programme to its current form.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding SGSY:
1. It was launched in April 1999.
2. It sought to bring assisted poor families above the poverty line.
3. It organised the rural poor into self-help groups and used group financing.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe SGSY, including its launch in April 1999, poverty-line objective and SHG-based group financing approach.
accepted.tq: Test a scheme through its launch date, objective and implementation approach.

accepted.s: The Swarna Jayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana was restructured in 2010 and launched in 2011 under which name?
accepted.x: SGSY was restructured as the National Rural Livelihoods Mission and launched as Aajeevika in 2011.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the immediate successor of SGSY from other rural and urban livelihood schemes.

accepted.s: The scheme launched on 1 April 1999 with the objective of bringing assisted poor families above the poverty line was
accepted.x: SGSY was launched on 1 April 1999 to bring assisted poor families above the poverty line through SHG-based group financing.
accepted.tq: Match the distinctive objective and launch date with the correct scheme.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the change from IRDP to SGSY?
o: Rural poverty programmes were replaced by urban street-vendor programmes.
Individual beneficiary approach was replaced by an SHG or group approach.
Bank credit was replaced entirely by government grants.
Training programmes were replaced by crop insurance.
accepted.x: IRDP followed an individual family or beneficiary approach, whereas SGSY adopted an SHG-based group approach.
accepted.tq: Use the reversed-comparison trap to distinguish two successive poverty programmes.

accepted.s:
Which of the following correctly describes IRDP?
1. It combined subsidy with bank credit.
2. It aimed to help poor rural families cross the poverty line.
3. It was implemented in all blocks from 2 October 1980.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: IRDP combined subsidy and bank credit, aimed at taking poor rural families above the poverty line, and covered all blocks from 2 October 1980.
accepted.tq: Verify a scheme through its financing pattern, objective and expansion date.

accepted.s: Training of Rural Youth for Self Employment is the full form of
accepted.x: TRYSEM stands for Training of Rural Youth for Self Employment and was started on 15 August 1979.
accepted.tq: Expand the exact acronym rather than selecting a similar rural-development programme.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: SITRA — Supply of Improved Toolkits to Rural Artisans
TRYSEM — Training of Rural Youth for Self Employment
DWCRA — Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas
Ganga Kalyan Yojana — General urban employment guarantee
accepted.x: Ganga Kalyan Yojana concerned bore-well and tube-well irrigation for small and marginal farmers, not urban employment guarantee. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the mismatched aim while the other pairs use exact official expansions.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following schemes in chronological order of their commencement:
A. SITRA
B. TRYSEM
C. DWCRA
D. Ganga Kalyan Yojana
accepted.x: TRYSEM began in 1979, DWCRA in 1982, SITRA in 1992 and Ganga Kalyan Yojana in 1997.
accepted.tq: Arrange programmes by their starting years, using the earliest and latest items first.

accepted.s: Ganga Kalyan Yojana was primarily associated with
o: irrigation through bore-wells and tube-wells for small and marginal farmers
group financing of urban street vendors
accepted.x: Ganga Kalyan Yojana provided bore-well and tube-well irrigation support to small and marginal farmers.
accepted.tq: Match a scheme with its specific beneficiary activity rather than its broad poverty label.

accepted.s: The South Asia Poverty Alleviation Programme (SAPAP) was implemented in Andhra Pradesh in 1995 in which districts?
accepted.x: SAPAP was implemented in Mahabubnagar, Kurnool and Anantapur in 1995.
accepted.tq: Test the location cluster of a state-level poverty alleviation initiative.

accepted.s: SAPAP in Andhra Pradesh was supported by which organisation?
accepted.x: The South Asia Poverty Alleviation Programme in Andhra Pradesh was supported by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
accepted.tq: Use the implementing-partner distinction to separate similar international agencies.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly traces the evolution of Velugu in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Velugu → Indira Kranthi Patham, implemented by SERP
accepted.x: Velugu was a World Bank-aided District Poverty Initiatives Project begun in 2000; it later became Indira Kranthi Patham and was run by SERP.
accepted.tq: Track both the renamed programme and its implementing agency.

accepted.s: Velugu, launched in 2000, was associated with which of the following?
o: A crop insurance programme for marginal farmers
A World Bank-aided District Poverty Initiatives Project
A centrally sponsored urban shelter programme
accepted.x: Velugu was the World Bank-aided District Poverty Initiatives Project in Andhra Pradesh, later known as Indira Kranthi Patham.
accepted.tq: Identify the programme through its external assistance and project character.

accepted.s: The Stree Nidhi Credit Cooperative Federation primarily provides SHG members with
o: timely credit in rural and urban areas
accepted.x: Stree Nidhi provides timely credit to self-help group members in both rural and urban areas.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a credit institution from training, housing and land-allocation agencies.

accepted.s: Unnati is a programme of SERP intended primarily for
o: all government employees below the poverty line
accepted.x: Unnati is a SERP programme targeted at the poorest Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe SHG households.
accepted.tq: Identify the target group from the scheme’s narrow beneficiary description.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh SHG interest-free loan arrangement is based on
o: interest charged only on delayed savings
complete waiver of all bank principal
direct lending by the United Nations
accepted.x: The Vaddi Leni Runalu or Sunna Vaddi arrangement provides interest subvention when SHG loans are repaid promptly.
accepted.tq: Apply the meaning of an interest-subvention arrangement to a repayment situation.

accepted.s: Which combination best represents the reported position of Andhra Pradesh in SHG–bank linkage?
o: Third rank, 36% of the national share and 90% recovery
First rank, 10% of the national share and 80% recovery
First rank, 36% of the national share and about 99.66% recovery
Second rank, 18% of the national share and 75% recovery
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is reported as ranking first in SHG–bank linkage, with 36% of the national share and about 99.66% recovery.
accepted.tq: Combine rank, percentage share and recovery figures without reversing the comparison.

accepted.s: The reported average rural disbursement under Andhra Pradesh’s SHG–bank linkage was approximately
accepted.x: The reported average disbursement in rural areas was approximately ₹32,190 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish closely related crore and lakh-crore figures by place value.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the correct institutional sequence under DAY-NRLM?
o: SHG → Block Secretariat → Urban Shelter Board
accepted.x: DAY-NRLM follows a three-tier institutional structure: Self-Help Group, Village Organisation and Cluster-Level Federation.
accepted.tq: Arrange institutional levels from the grassroots group to the federation.

accepted.s:
The Panchasutras under DAY-NRLM include which of the following?
1. Regular meetings
2. Savings
3. Internal lending
4. Recoveries and maintenance of books
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Panchasutras comprise regular meetings, savings, internal lending, recoveries and proper maintenance of books.
accepted.tq: Recognise the complete standard-practice list by checking every component.

accepted.s: DAY-NRLM is implemented by which Ministry?
o: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
accepted.x: DAY-NRLM is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
accepted.tq: Use the rural-versus-urban ministry distinction to identify the responsible authority.

accepted.s: DAY-NRLM is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme with the usual Centre–State funding ratio of
accepted.x: The usual funding ratio is 60:40. The ratio is 90:10 for the North-Eastern States including Sikkim and 100% for Union Territories.
accepted.tq: Separate the general funding ratio from the special regional exceptions.

accepted.s: Under DAY-NRLM, the rural poor are identified primarily through
o: a national examination conducted by banks
Participatory Identification of Poor, vetted by the Gram Sabha
accepted.x: Eligible rural poor women are identified through Participatory Identification of Poor (PIP), with the list vetted by the Gram Sabha.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct authority and participatory method in a beneficiary-selection scenario.

accepted.s: Which statement regarding eligibility under DAY-NRLM is correct?
o: Only households entirely below the poverty line can have SHG members.
Only urban households can join SHGs.
Eligibility is restricted to male household heads.
Up to 30% of SHG members may be slightly above the poverty line.
accepted.x: Although the focus is on rural poor women, up to 30% of SHG members may be slightly above the poverty line.
accepted.tq: Test the exception to an otherwise broad eligibility rule.

accepted.s: Which of the following best reflects the reported scale of DAY-NRLM?
o: About 1 crore households in 9.1 lakh SHGs, 53,500 VOs and 3,355 CLFs
About 100 crore households in 9.1 crore SHGs, 53.5 lakh VOs and 3,35,580 CLFs
About 10 lakh households in 91,000 SHGs, 5,350 VOs and 335 CLFs
About 10 crore households in 91 lakh SHGs, 5.35 lakh VOs and 33,558 CLFs
accepted.x: DAY-NRLM covers approximately 10 crore households through 91 lakh SHGs, 5.35 lakh Village Organisations and 33,558 Cluster-Level Federations.
accepted.tq: Match a scheme with its complete scale profile while guarding against shifted place values.

accepted.s: The bank credit mobilised under DAY-NRLM is reported to have crossed
accepted.x: Bank credit under DAY-NRLM has crossed ₹11 lakh crore, with reported non-performing assets of about 1.7%.
accepted.tq: Use magnitude and place-value discrimination for large financial figures.

accepted.s: A ‘Lakhpati Didi’ under the relevant livelihood initiative is an SHG member who earns at least
accepted.x: A Lakhpati Didi is an SHG member earning ₹1 lakh or more annually.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the official income threshold from nearby numerical distractors.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the reported Lakhpati Didi milestones?
o: The number crossed 20 lakh and the target was raised to 60 lakh by March 2029.
The number crossed 1 crore and the target was fixed at 3 crore by March 2029.
The number crossed 2 crore and the target was raised to 6 crore by March 2029.
The number crossed 6 crore and the target was reduced to 2 crore by March 2029.
accepted.x: The number of Lakhpati Didis crossed 2 crore, and the target was raised to 6 crore by March 2029.
accepted.tq: Separate an achieved milestone from a future target and check their order.

accepted.s: The Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP) under DAY-NRLM focuses on
o: only irrigation wells for marginal farmers
accepted.x: SVEP, launched in 2016, promotes non-farm enterprises among SHG households.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its sectoral focus and beneficiary base.

accepted.s: Which statement about SVEP is correct?
o: It supports 4.32 lakh enterprises, with women constituting at least 60%.
It supports 43.2 lakh enterprises, with women constituting exactly 30%.
It supports only agricultural cooperatives and has no gender component.
It supports 4.32 lakh enterprises, all owned by men.
accepted.x: SVEP has supported about 4.32 lakh enterprises, and women account for at least 60% of participation or ownership as reported.
accepted.tq: Check both the programme scale and the gender composition rather than one figure alone.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT listed as a component or associated initiative of DAY-NRLM?
accepted.x: MKSP, AGEY and DDU-GKY are associated with DAY-NRLM. SUSV is a component of DAY-NULM for urban street vendors.
accepted.tq: Separate rural livelihood components from an urban livelihood component.

accepted.s: BC Sakhis, the SARATHI app and the Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana are associated with
accepted.x: BC Sakhis, the SARATHI app and Samaveshi Aajeevika Yojana are listed among DAY-NRLM initiatives; the last follows a graduation approach.
accepted.tq: Group related initiatives under the correct rural livelihoods mission.

accepted.s: The Ministry associated with DAY-NULM was originally known as the Ministry of
accepted.x: DAY-NULM was associated with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation, now the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the former and current name of the urban-affairs ministry.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with DAY-NULM?
o: PAISA — Public Agricultural Irrigation Support Authority
SUSV — Support to Rural Village Organisations
SUH — Shelter for Urban Households only above the poverty line
SM&ID — Social Mobilisation and Institution Development
accepted.x: SM&ID stands for Social Mobilisation and Institution Development. SUSV concerns urban street vendors, SUH concerns urban homeless persons, and PAISA is a credit and interest-subvention portal.
accepted.tq: Use exact expansions and detect altered words in closely related urban components.

accepted.s: Which of the following is a component of DAY-NULM?
o: Supply of Improved Toolkits to Rural Artisans
Training of Rural Youth for Self Employment
accepted.x: Support to Urban Street Vendors (SUSV) is a DAY-NULM component. The other options refer to rural programmes or sub-schemes.
accepted.tq: Separate an urban livelihood component from rural poverty sub-schemes.

accepted.s: PAISA under DAY-NULM stands for
o: Portal for Affordable Credit and Interest Subvention Access
Programme for Agricultural Investment and Savings Assistance
Poverty Alleviation and Income Support Authority
Public Assistance Initiative for Social Advancement
accepted.x: PAISA means Portal for Affordable Credit and Interest Subvention Access.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official expansion of a short scheme-related acronym.

accepted.s: The agency implementing DAY-NULM in Andhra Pradesh is
accepted.x: MEPMA, the Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas, is the implementing agency for DAY-NULM in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the urban implementing agency from the rural agency SERP.

accepted.s: MEPMA, the Andhra Pradesh agency associated with DAY-NULM, was established on
accepted.x: The Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas (MEPMA) was established on 1 September 2007.
accepted.tq: Match an institutional establishment date with the correct agency.

accepted.s: Which one of the following combinations consists entirely of direct-attack poverty programmes?
accepted.x: IRDP, NREP, RLEGP and JRY are listed as direct-attack or target-group poverty programmes.
accepted.tq: Identify the common programme family rather than matching only one item.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: JRY was associated with the Seventh Plan and began in 1989, not the Sixth Plan in 1980. The other matches are correct.
accepted.tq: Catch the wrong plan-year association in a list of closely related programmes.

accepted.s: The direct-attack strategy in poverty alleviation replaced reliance on
o: trickle-down from the Fifth and Sixth Plans
accepted.x: Target-group programmes under the direct-attack strategy replaced reliance on the trickle-down approach associated with the Fifth and Sixth Plans.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a change in poverty-alleviation strategy from changes in individual schemes.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is the odd one out with reference to direct-attack poverty programmes?
accepted.x: NREP, RLEGP and JRY are direct-attack poverty programmes, whereas a crop insurance programme belongs to a different policy category.
accepted.tq: Find the non-poverty programme among a group of target-group poverty initiatives.
